Condition : 1 - 
	THAT THE CERTIFICATE OF LAWFULNESS IS GRANTED
The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on the 20 September 2002, the use of the premises as offices only for the administration of a mini-cab business with no pick-ups or drop-offs at the site, is lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The business involves the use of the premises as offices for the administration of a mini-cab business . There is no material change of use of part or whole of the 	building and therefore planning permission is not required.
description: Certificate of Lawfulnes for the continued use of premises for office use in connection with a chauffers business.
